    Gluing two orthogonal bricks along a non-split extension #

    For Kronecker modules C, B and maps α, β : V_B → W_C, the extension module E(α, β) has V = V_C × V_B, W = W_C × W_B and block upper-triangular arrow maps. If C and B are Hom-orthogonal bricks and the extension does not split ((α, β) is not of the form (a_C φ − ψ a_B, b_C φ − ψ b_B)), then E(α, β) is a brick (Bricks.isBrick_ext). This is the basic step for building large bricks by gluing (route note on Göbel–Simson).
